system.description:
The shadows already in the room answer you. At a thought they deepen, lengthen, flicker and undulate, taking on a cloying, hellish quality as they bend to your will.

Spend a Blood Trait; the effect lasts a scene or an hour and can influence one individual. Wrapping the shades around yourself to hide grants one bonus Trait on all stealth and ranged-combat challenges; drawing them into a terrifying mantle instead grants one bonus Trait on intimidation challenges — both automatic. To attack, win a challenge of your Mental Traits versus the victim's Physical Traits: the target gains the Negative Trait Clumsy and is asphyxiated, and a mortal with three or fewer current Physical Traits loses one Physical Trait per turn, then one Health Level per turn once those run out, choking to death if the darkness is not broken.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
